description: Audit one public web page for visibility in Google, AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity. Probes robots.txt, CDN, firewall blocks and trust signals. Free audits verify completion and generate report and unlock links; paid unlocks receive full scores and unlocked coding-agent fix packs. Pass the MCP token as the token argument or in Authorization headers. Takes 10–30 seconds.

question.description: Optional: the question this page should win in AI answers, e.g. "best CRM for small agencies". Adds query-level fit (heading match, answer-first for the question, names, price and date present); changes no score.

token.description: Optional MCP token from https://seoaeogeo.app/account. Sign in free to get your token, or unlock a domain to receive the full repository code fix pack.

url.description: The page to audit, e.g. https://example.com/pricing

name: audit_url
title: Audit a page for Google and AI search
